text: {"lessons":["After several months of holding through declines, I should review whether each position still fits my risk limits rather than letting reluctance to realize a loss keep me inactive.","Buying more of every stock after prices had fallen increased my exposure without evidence that the dips were bargains; I should size purchases deliberately and preserve cash.","I should judge decisions by their effect on the whole portfolio and a consistent plan, not by the satisfaction of locking in gains or the pain of selling at a loss."]}
